Output gallery

output-gallery.Rmd

Every image below shows an output generated with potentiomap. Synthetic head values are labeled as synthetic units and should not be interpreted as field elevations. Warm colors represent higher modeled head and cool colors represent lower modeled head; contours, symbols, and arrowheads provide non-color cues.

Hydraulic-gradient arrows in this gallery indicate decreasing modeled head. They do not represent groundwater velocity, travel time, particle paths, or contaminant transport.
